evals.prompt: Create an HTML presentation about our Q4 2025 quarterly results. We grew revenue 47% YoY to $2.4M ARR, added 12 enterprise customers, and expanded to 3 new markets. The audience is our board of directors. Make it look premium and executive — think dark theme, big numbers, clean typography. About 8 slides.
evals.expected_output: A single .html file with 8 slides including: dark title slide, stats slide with counting animations, market expansion slide, customer growth slide, key takeaway, and closing CTA. Professional executive palette, distinctive fonts, keyboard navigation working, slide counter visible.

assertions.text: Output is a single .html file with no external dependencies except Google Fonts
Contains at least 7 and at most 10 <section> elements with class 'slide'
Uses CSS custom properties on :root for colors and fonts
Includes keyboard navigation JavaScript (ArrowRight, ArrowLeft handlers)
Contains @media (prefers-reduced-motion) wrapper for animations
Slide counter element is present and updates
Stat values ($2.4M, 47%, 12) appear in the presentation
Does not use Inter, Roboto, or Arial as primary font
Dark slides use consistent dark background color from palette

evals.prompt: I need a pitch deck as an HTML presentation for my AI startup called NeuralFlow. We do real-time ML inference optimization — reducing latency by 10x and costs by 60%. Target audience is Series A investors. I want it to feel modern and techy but not cliché — no purple gradients please. Include slides for: problem, solution, market size ($47B by 2027), traction (200+ customers, $1.2M ARR), team, and ask ($15M Series A). Make it interactive with nice animations.
evals.expected_output: Single .html file pitch deck with ~10 slides. Modern tech aesthetic with distinctive palette (not purple gradients). Animated stat counters for $47B, 200+, $1.2M, $15M. Fragment animations for bullet points. Card grid for team. Smooth slide transitions. Keyboard nav + progress bar.

assertions.text: Output is a single .html file
Contains slide for each requested topic: problem, solution, market, traction, team, ask
Does not use purple gradient backgrounds
Includes counter animation JavaScript for stat values
Has fragment elements that reveal on keypress
Progress bar element exists
Contains @import for Google Fonts
All slides have scroll-snap-align property

evals.prompt: Make me a simple 5-slide HTML presentation about the benefits of remote work. Keep it clean and minimal — I just want something I can share as a link with my team. Light theme, nothing too fancy but should have smooth transitions between slides.
evals.expected_output: Clean, minimal 5-slide HTML file. Light palette, simple animations (fade/slide up), keyboard navigation, no overly complex effects. Professional but approachable. Easy to share as a file.

assertions.text: Output is a single .html file
Contains exactly 5 <section> elements with class 'slide'
Uses a light color scheme (white or near-white backgrounds for content slides)
Includes keyboard navigation
Has smooth transition CSS (scroll-behavior: smooth or transition properties)
Does not include particle effects or complex background animations
Contains @media print stylesheet
